name: Punctuation
description: Fine-grained use of punctuation (. , ! ? ; : - quotes) and clause boundaries to prevent run-on sentences, missing commas, improper apostrophes, and punctuation fragments.
probe_prompts: Add correct punctuation and capitalization to: although it was raining we decided to go for a run in the park
Separate into proper sentences: the training loop finished successfully loss dropped steadily we saved the checkpoint
Punctuate correctly: its important to check the models outputs before saving it to disk
Add direct quotation marks and commas: she said we will evaluate the results tomorrow morning
Fix the missing serial commas and punctuation: we need to buy apples oranges bananas and grapes for the smoothie
Punctuate this complex sentence: whenever the learning rate is too high gradients explode and training fails
Fix comma splice: the model converged quickly, it achieved ninety percent accuracy
Add question mark or period appropriately: can you explain why the loss did not decrease during epoch two
Fix hyphenation and apostrophe: the user interface was well designed but the students code had many errors
Punctuate semicolon usage: the dataset was small nevertheless the performance was impressive
probe_expected_behaviors: Output must add appropriate punctuation marks (periods, commas, question marks, quotes)
Output must fix capitalization at sentence boundaries
Output must eliminate comma splices and run-on sentences
Output must maintain original sentence meaning while fixing punctuation
